(i) the problem of finding a minimum target set for a given coverage threshold is NP-hard, (ii) it can be solved approximately in polynomial time using a greedy algorithm that is guaranteed to find a set whose size is at most twice the optimal size and whose coverage is at least 1/2 the optimal coverage, (iii) the problem of minimizing the time to reach a given coverage is NP-hard, even when we restrict the coverage to 50% of the nodes, and

(a) MINTIME is NP-hard and even approximability within a constant factor is hard, (b) MINTSS is NP-hard and a simple greedy algorithm achieves a bicriteria approximation, and (c) the bicriteria approximation is hard to improve.
